name: 02b_logroll_backboard
title: Log roll onto a backboard
subtitle: A rolls the patient toward itself as one unit, B slides the backboard against the back, A rolls the patient back onto it, then both lift the board by its end hand holds.

captions.text: The patient lies on the road shoulder. The backboard waits on the far side.
Arms are crossed on the chest so they stay in line during the roll.
A stoops and reaches across to the far shoulder and the far hip.
A rolls the patient toward itself as one unit, so head, shoulders and hips turn together.
B slides the backboard in against the patient's back.
A rolls the patient back, flat onto the board.
Both walk around to the ends of the board.
They stoop at the ends and take the hand holds.
On the count: both ends rise at the same rate, so the board stays level.
Board level at hand height, ready to carry to the cot.
